t: What Supply Substitution Database Is All About
title: What Supply Substitution Database Is All About
description: Supply substitution qualifies alternatives: second-source materials, alternate suppliers, reformulated components — each approved by engineering (form/fit/function), quality (PPAP), and testing. The approved-substitute list prevents panic buying of wrong parts. Substitute proactively in calm; never improvisationally in crisis. This database is the complete substitution record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
